seg-001.note: real work: decisions, a dead end, tool errors

seg-002.note: insight with no error — the case keyword filters miss; default-keep must catch it

seg-004.note: lint run: a linter's own aggregate summary line ('Found 3 errors (3 fixed, 0 remaining)') with no exception traceback — the canonical skip. The discriminator from seg-006 (also an in-segment resolved error, but 'keep') is traceback-vs-summary-line, not resolved-vs-unresolved: a 'the error count came back to 0' rule alone would wrongly skip seg-006 too, since it also resolves within the segment.

seg-006.note: ACCEPTED FALSE POSITIVE: a typo-error segment trips the error rule — its tool_result contains an actual exception traceback (NameError), not just a linter's summary line like seg-004's — so a traceback-vs-summary-line rule keeps it distinct from seg-004's skip; recall-tuning means we pay NPU time here rather than risk skipping real errors

seg-007.note: ACCEPTED FALSE POSITIVE: grep output containing the word 'error'; a keyword triage cannot tell mentions from failures, and skipping on this rule would also skip real failures
